My results

My journey — my numbers, not a promise.

My results

I was tired of feeling tired. Tired of the fatigue, tired of watching numbers I didn't understand. So I started tracking gently, with love for myself — three drinks, one window, 90 days.

Where I started

Being a mom at 44 with little kids, it was hard to keep up. Sluggish mornings, migraines, back pains, cravings, poor sleep, and I was in the pre-diabetic range.

What I did

Unimate in the morning, Unimate again around lunch, Balance with my biggest meal, then fast after dinner — most often 16 hours not eating, 8 hours eating. No starvation diet. I tracked my own numbers instead of going by feel.

Where I landed

  • Your results here — add only your own, true results, with your own baseline. Do not copy someone else's numbers.

That's my starting point and my result. Yours starts with your own baseline — and we'll track it together, so you can watch your own numbers move.

These are my personal results, not a promise of yours, and not a claim that a supplement cures anything.

The routine behind the numbers

My labs, with love

These are my own results, shared in my own words and in the screenshots below. They are personal stories, not medical advice, and not a promise of your results. If you take medication, talk to your provider first, and never change a dose because of a post.

From my lab message (CBC collected Apr 8, 2026): Overall, my lab work looked good. My cholesterol was slightly elevated — total cholesterol 230 (we like this less than 200), LDL 143 (we like this less than 100), HDL 72 (we like this above 60, so this is good). My A1c was negative — I am no longer in the prediabetes range. All other blood work was unremarkable.

From my CBC with differential video: Every value below was in its normal range in the portal.
